name: Bardolino

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A DOC on the moraine hills east of Lake Garda in Verona province, for red wine and the rosé Chiaretto, which may also be sparkling. Corvina leads the blend, with Rondinella, and Molinara is now optional.
